label: Ark Coding Plan Lite
limits: About 1,200 requests per 5 hours, about 9,000 per week, about 18,000 per subscription month (Volcengine articles). 5-hour window counted from first request; weekly resets Monday 00:00; monthly from purchase date.
notes: The official page loads prices dynamically ('价格查询中'); it only states '限时 9.9 元起'. The ¥40/mo list price is secondary. USD is my conversion at about 7.1 CNY/USD. Promo: first two months at 25% of list (¥9.9) until 2026-11-08 (secondary). China region only. Volcengine articles say quota works only in supported coding tools and API use outside them may be treated as abuse.

label: Ark Coding Plan Pro
limits: '5 倍于 Lite 套餐的用量' (official page); about 6,000 per 5 hours, 45,000 per week, 90,000 per month (Volcengine articles).
notes: ¥200/mo list (secondary) at about 7.1 CNY/USD; promo ¥49.9 for the first two months.
